notes.title: Reek 1.2 - The Peristalsis Update
notes.notes:
Reek 1.2 
The Peristalsis Update

the new shit:
Respawn mechanic added
The player now has three lives per level. 
When he dies, he spawns at a point you have set before.
Janitors
Pieces of janitors can no longer hurt other janitors.
New janitor headshot mechanic.
In your favorite level S-10 the janitors explode with every hit.
General
The fans are now quieter and have a new mechanic.
Tutorial is shorter.
New animations for walking, standing and falling.
All fluids are now more squishy.
The s**t projectile always causes a splash now.
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Controller update
notes.notes:
It is now possible to play the whole game with a controller only.

New features and fixes:

 The interface has been adapted for the controller. 
 The menu navigation in the main menu was changed a little bit.
 Several controller icons added.
 The statistics in "Credits+Statistic" are now displayed correctly.
 The volume slider in the start menu is now less sensitive.
 The crosshairs no longer fly away when aiming with a controller. 
 It is now possible to switch between controller and mouse at any time, simply by pressing a key.
 The game now has its own small Courser, because the standard Courser was too boring.
 If you stop flying, the diarrhea sound is pitched up. "Pfffiiiiiit"
